sloka: स दत्त्वा तुमुलं युद्धं रावणस्य दुरात्मनः ।विसृजन्नेव बाणौघान् सुषेणं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.१०२.२ ।।
transliteration: sa dattvā tumulaṁ yuddhaṁ rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ ।visṛjanneva bāṇaughān suṣeṇaṁ vākyamabravīt ।। 6.102.2 ।।

translations.english: Seeing Lakshmana struck by exceedingly mighty, evil minded Ravana's javelin and soaked in blood Rama giving intense fight by discharging arrows also spoke as follows to Sushena.
